title: Service on occupants.
officialText:
Service may be made upon an occupant by delivering such notice to the occupant or to a
person employed by the occupant to work at or to manage or maintain the premises at which the nuisance is located; or by affixing
such notice to the premises at which the nuisance is located in a conspicuous place or by placing a copy under the entrance door
of such premises and mailing a copy of such notice to the occupant at such premises; and in all instances except personal delivery
upon such occupant, by mailing the notice of hearing to the occupant at the premises at which the nuisance is located.
